name: MDC Octree Isosurface Extraction
definition: An isosurface extraction algorithm using an octree data structure (MDC_Octree) to adaptively subdivide a 3D volume. It processes cells, faces, and edges recursively to generate a triangle mesh, handling topology via vertex clustering and collapse logic.
summary: MDC Octree Isosurface Extraction is an adaptive algorithm that generates manifold triangle meshes from volumetric data by explicitly managing vertex clustering across shared edges and faces to resolve topological ambiguities.
